segments.name: UACC
segments.description: An indirect automotive finance company offering vehicle financing to non-prime consumers through a nationwide network of motor vehicle dealers.
segments.evidence: UACC is an indirect lender that offers vehicle financing under the UACC brand to consumers through a network of motor vehicle dealers, focusing primarily on the non-prime market.

segments.name: CarStory
segments.description: Sells AI-powered analytics and digital services to automotive dealers, automotive financial services companies and others in the automotive industry.
segments.evidence: The CarStory reportable segment represents sales of AI-powered analytics and digital services to automotive dealers, automotive financial services companies and others in the automotive industry.

revenueModel.text: UACC earns interest and servicing income from vehicle retail installment sales contracts purchased from dealers, while CarStory earns revenue from sales of AI-powered analytics and digital services to automotive industry customers.
revenueModel.evidence: UACC acquires and services finance receivables from its network of third-party dealership customers and generates interest income.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company discontinued its Ecommerce and Wholesale segments following the wind-down of its used vehicle ecommerce operations under the Value Maximization Plan.
changes.evidence: As a result of the Value Maximization Plan and the wind-down of our ecommerce operations, we discontinued reporting our results through our Ecommerce and Wholesale segments starting in the first quarter of 2024.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company substantially completed the wind-down of its used vehicle dealership business, ceasing transactions through vroom.com.
changes.evidence: As of March 29, 2024, the Company substantially completed the wind-down of its used vehicle dealership business (the "Ecommerce Wind-Down") and ended all sales and marketing activities for its used vehicle operations.
